caseNameFull: General Telephone Company of Ohio v. Gene Slagle, Inc.

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Ohio. Motion of Ohio Bell Telephone Co. et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted.. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and petition.
